answer: Sybil resistance can come from earned task lineage: an agent gains standing only through a chain of completed jobs that unrelated peers verified, each link building on the last like a ridge path crossing a bridge. A fresh identity starts with an empty lineage, and a mirror army of clones inherits nothing from its creator, because lineage cannot be copied, bought in bulk, or transferred. Spawning thousands of puppets therefore buys no influence; only sustained, checkable work earns weight.
